title: Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator (Remote - UTS Group)
description:
Are you a detail-driven professional with experience in security and low-voltage system design and estimating? UTS Group is expanding our technical team and we want to hear from you.

UTS Group is a leading North American security integration company serving clients across Canada and the U.S. We specialize in Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, Automatic Doors, and full low-voltage infrastructure. We are looking for a Security & Low-Voltage Designer / Estimator who can review drawings, analyze tenders, design system layouts, and prepare accurate cost estimates for complex projects.

This is a remote, full-time role, working Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).

⸻

Position Overview

This hybrid role blends design and estimating. You will review construction drawings, bids, and tender packages, then translate them into complete design documents, material takeoffs, and competitive estimates. You’ll prepare layouts, risers, and technical specifications using AutoCAD and Bluebeam, while collaborating with project managers, sales teams, and vendors to ensure accuracy and compliance.

⸻

Key Responsibilities

• Review and interpret technical drawings, floor plans, door schedules, and tender documents

• Design integrated security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Intercom)

• Design low-voltage/data systems including structured cabling, network racks, and pathways

• Prepare material take-offs (MTO), labour estimates, and detailed cost proposals

• Produce layouts, risers, and markups using AutoCAD and Bluebeam

• Develop and submit accurate quotations and bid packages

• Collaborate with sales, PMs, and vendors to confirm pricing, timelines, and compatibility

• Maintain organized records of estimates, proposals, drawings, and documentation

• Participate in handover meetings for awarded projects

• Contribute to continuous improvement of estimating templates and design standards

⸻

Must-Have Qualifications

• 2–3+ years of experience in security system estimating or low-voltage design

• Proven ability to read and interpret construction drawings and tender documents

• Strong proficiency with AutoCAD and Bluebeam Revu

• Solid understanding of low-voltage systems, wiring methods, and structured cabling standards (TIA/EIA)

• Experience with quoting Access Control, CCTV, Intercom, Door Hardware, and related systems

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Proficiency with Office 365 (Excel, Outlook, Word)

• Ability to work remotely with strong self-management and organization

• Experience with Zoho CRM/Books or similar platforms is an asset

⸻

Nice to Have

• Education in Engineering, Architecture, Technology, or related fields

• Knowledge of Canadian and U.S. security/building codes

• Experience preparing technical submittals or shop drawings

• French language proficiency

⸻

Work Details

• Location: Remote

• Type: Full-time

• Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM ET

title: UGC Coordinator
description:
UGC Coordinator About Us:

We are a DTC company who creates direct response ads. Our marketing team makes scripts for ads that sometimes needs UGC creators to film them. This is how you will fit into our company.

About the Role

We’re looking for a UGC Coordinator to own and lead our creator operations end-to-end. 

This role is critical to keeping our content engine moving: sourcing top-tier creators, managing relationships, anticipating roadblocks, negotiating UGC costs, and ensuring deliverables flow smoothly from concept to edit-ready.

You’ll be the point person between creators, Creative Strategists, and Operations , bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to a high-volume, fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on organization, takes initiative, and solves problems independently.

Key Responsibilities
  • Own the full creator lifecycle, from sourcing and vetting to delivery and payment
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, ensuring clear expectations, timelines, and communication
  • Act as the operational hub for all creator-related projects, keeping internal tools (Notion, Slack, etc) accurate, up to date, and easy to understand at a glance
  • Proactively track progress across all concepts and creators, identifying risks, delays, or gaps before they escalate
  • Coordinate closely with Creative Strategists to ensure creators are fully aligned on briefs, constraints, and deliverables
  • Ensure seamless handoff of content to post-production, with well-organized assets and clear documentation
  • Handle reshoots, revisions, and edge cases with a solution-first mindset
  • Manage & negotiate creator payments and documentation in a timely and organized manner
What Success Looks Like
  • Anyone opening our tracking systems can instantly understand the status of every creator and deliverable
  • Creators feel supported, informed, and motivated to deliver high-quality content on time
  • Issues are flagged early, communicated clearly, and resolved efficiently
  • Content moves forward without bottlenecks, confusion, or last-minute fire drills
Required Qualities
  • Highly organized : able to manage multiple creators, timelines, and deliverables simultaneously
  • Proactive and accountable : you don’t wait to be asked—you move things forward
  • Problem-solver : able to find creative solutions independently before escalating
  • Strong communicator : clear, concise, and professional across Slack, email, and documentation
  • Detail-oriented but execution-focused : you balance precision with speed
Experience & Background
  • Proven experience working with creators, talent, or influencers (UGC content preferred)
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-output environment
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with creative, operations, and production teams
Why This Role Matters

This role is central to how our creative machine runs. As a UGC coordinator, you ensure that ideas turn into real, usable content—on time, organized, and ready to perform. Your work directly impacts creative velocity, team alignment, and overall results.

Compensation & Perks:

Base Salary from $2,000-$3,250 USD per month

Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)

Fully Remote

Time Zone: EST

title: Analista de Educação Corporativa Sênior
description:

title: Técnico(a) de Serviços
description:
Resumo do cargo:

Responsável por executar atividades de assistência técnica, comissionamento, manutenção e configuração em computadores de vazão e presets da linha Emerson. Atuação em campo e na fábrica, suportando clientes, equipe de engenharia e projetos de medição fiscal e operacional.

  • Conduzir Verificação Inicial de computadores de vazão junto aos órgãos metrológicos (IPEM/INMETRO);
  • Apoiar o time de engenharia na execução de projetos, participando de testes de fábrica (TAF), testes de aceitação em campo (TAC), comissionamento e start-up de sistemas;
  • Prestar suporte técnico à base instalada, identificando falhas, realizando análise de causa raiz e solucionando problemas de hardware, software e comunicação;
  • Executar reparos internos em equipamentos enviados pelos clientes, incluindo análise, substituição de componentes e testes funcionais;
  • Seguir procedimentos técnicos e requisitos de segurança (EHS), mantendo conformidade com normas internas e regulatórias.

Quem você é:

Você antecipa as necessidades dos clientes e fornece serviços que vão além de suas expectativas. Toma medidas rápidas e decisivas em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam os fatos. Você sempre mantém o objetivo em vista e faz um esforço extra para cumprir os prazos.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em serviços de campo, preferencialmente em sistemas de medição de vazão (gás natural, líquidos ou combustíveis);
  • Experiência prática em configuração, parametrização e diagnóstico de computadores de vazão;
  • Conhecimento em comunicações industriais (Modbus, HART, Ethernet, RS-485);
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de diagramas elétricos e P&ID;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes e trabalhos em campo.

Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:

  • Experiência em terminais de combustíveis, especialmente em sistemas de carregamento com presets automáticos;
  • Conhecimento no uso de ferramentas de diagnóstico e softwares de configuração da Emerson (FBxConnect, ROCLINK, AMS, entre outros);
  • Experiência com instrumentação e medidores de vazão.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Assistente de Pesquisa
description:
Faça parte da revolução na produtividade do canavial brasileiro e impulsione a bioenergia rumo a um mundo descarbonizado!

Estamos em busca de um Assistente de Pesquisa para fortalecer nossa operação no Projeto Agronomia Sementes , garantindo a execução de ensaios agronômicos com qualidade, precisão e confiabilidade — pilares fundamentais para o avanço das próximas fases do projeto.

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar todas as etapas de preparação e execução de ensaios experimentais em campo, sob orientação técnica de representantes técnicos e pesquisadores.
  • Realizar a coleta de dados de acordo com protocolos pré-estabelecidos, garantindo precisão e rastreabilidade.
  • Executar montagem de áreas experimentais, aplicação de tratamentos, avaliações e demais atividades como interpretação de dados e revisão de literatura;
  • Contribuir para a organização dos materiais, equipamentos e insumos utilizados nas atividades de campo.
  • Apoiar a organização de banco de dados e entrada de dados em sistemas e planilhas;
  • Colaborar com a tabulação de dados e elaboração de apresentações ou relatórios técnicos.
  • Cumprir rigorosamente os procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) definidos pela equipe CTC.
  • Apoiar a logística de campo, como transporte de equipamentos e suporte à equipe nos locais de ensaio.
  • Reportar anomalias, falhas ou desvios observados durante a execução dos protocolos.
  • Manter postura colaborativa e comprometida com a qualidade e o resultado das pesquisas.
  • Operar drones para avaliações de ensaios via imagem.

Conhecimentos Obrigatórios:

  • Conhecimento em manejos agrícolas ou atividades relacionadas a campo.
  • Noções de montagem e condução de ensaios, coleta de dados ou apoio à pesquisa.
  • Capacidade de trabalho em ambiente de campo, com boa organização e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Habilidade para seguir protocolos técnicos e padrões operacionais.

Formação:

  • Engenharia Agronômica, Engenharia Agrícola, Engenharia Florestal ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com atividades experimentais ou plantio de cana ou trabalhos agrícolas de campo.
  • Noções na cultura da cana-de-açúcar, condução de ensaios, manejo agrícola, coleta e registro de dados.
  • Habilitação: CNH categoria B (obrigatório).
  • Disponibilidade: Para viagens e permanência em campo durante períodos críticos dos ensaios.

Benefícios da posição:

  • Participação nos Resultados
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Auxílio Medicamento
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Previdência Privada
  • Alimentação: Restaurante no CTC
  • Fretado – Piracicaba ou Campinas
  • Gympass / Wellhub

No CTC - Centro de Tecnologia Canavieira , cada dia é uma oportunidade de expandir os limites da genética e do manejo da cana-de-açúcar , desenvolvendo soluções inovadoras para um mundo mais sustentável.

Por que escolher o CTC?

title: Supplier Quality Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 355 systems supplied into 28 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.

The Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of supplier-manufactured components and systems used in RNG equipment. This role leads supplier qualification, audits, testing, and continuous improvement activities to maintain high quality standards across the supply chain.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Qualify, audit, and develop suppliers to ensure robust manufacturing and quality systems (NCR, CAPA, PPAP/APQP).
  • Assess supplier manufacturing capability and mitigate quality and delivery risks.
  • Drive supplier performance improvement aligned with quality, cost, and delivery targets.
  • Lead product and process qualification activities at supplier sites.
  • Plan and execute FAT and SAT activities for components and fully assembled RNG systems.
  • Review test procedures, validate instrumentation, document non-conformances, and issue acceptance reports.
  • Develop and implement inspection plans, test procedures, SOPs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage non-conforming supplier components and oversee root cause investigations using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Ishikawa).
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable codes and standards (ASME, ASTM, AWS, NR13).
  • Identify cost reduction and quality improvement opportunities with supply chain and engineering teams.
  • Lead Kaizen and standardized work initiatives at supplier facilities.
  • Maintain accurate records of supplier processes, audits, test results, and corrective actions.
  • Prepare technical documentation, databooks, and management reports.
  • Partner with internal teams (manufacturing, purchasing, QA/QC).
  • Train and mentor quality personnel on qualification, testing, and inspection processes.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years in manufacturing or quality roles; 1–3+ years in Supplier Quality Engineering.
  • Strong understanding of integrated process systems (e.g., gas processing, upgrading systems, controls).
  • Strong technical capability with Supplier audits, FAT/SAT leadership, GD&T, P&ID interpretation, ISO 9001, root cause analysis.
  • Preferred with knowledge in standards as ASTM A516 Gr.70, ABNT NBR 6656 USI SAC 50, ABNT NR-12, NR-13, ASME VIII Div.1, ISO 2768-mK, MTC EN 10204 Type 3.1, ANSI class, AWS A2.4, ASTM A36, ABNT NBR 7007 MR250, and SSPC-SP6/SP10.
  • Experience working directly with customers and plant operators in on-site environments.
  • Ability to work across functions and influence without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, concise updates to leadership.
  • English proficiency required.

How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
TGG Way Accounting Manager

Location: Fully Remote working for US-Based Clients

About Us

We are a dynamic and growing accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.

Key Responsibilities

Month-End Close & Core Accounting

  • Prepare and review journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Support the month-end close process following established checklists
  • Review P&L and balance sheet for accuracy before submission to the Controller
  • Maintain organized supporting documentation and workpapers

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow)
  • Perform basic variance analysis and flag inconsistencies
  • Ensure consistency and accuracy across financial reports and schedules

Accounting Operations

  • Review AP, AR, and credit card reconciliations
  • Support payroll processing and review prior to submission
  • Maintain and review the chart of accounts
  • Assist with recurring weekly and monthly accounting processes

Team Support & Review

  • Review work prepared by junior accountants or bookkeepers
  • Provide guidance, feedback, and basic training as needed
  • Ensure data accuracy and adherence to internal processes

Client & Internal Collaboration

  • Communicate with internal team members regarding open items and deadlines
  • Support client requests and questions under Controller supervision
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and escalate recommendations

Requirements

  • 4+ years of accounting experience
  • Experience working with U.S.-based clients and exposure to U.S. GAAP
  • Strong understanding of month-end close, journal entries, and reconciliations
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks Online or NetSuite (preferred)
  • Strong Excel skills (formulas, data organization, basic analysis)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Accounting or Finance degree
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Can work US Timezone schedules (such as PST, EST)

Compensation & Benefits

  • USD 2,500–3,500 per month , based on experience
  • Fully remote role with some flexibility included
  • Paid training in U.S. GAAP and internal processes
  • Access to TGG University and learning resources
  • Career development / Long-term growth opportunities within a global firm
  • Unlimited PTO after onboarding period (holidays included)

Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked (can be 8 or 4 hours per day)

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave

About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world, in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: ANALISTA CONTÁBIL FISCAL
description:
Resumo do cargo

Buscamos uma pessoa para a posição de  Analista Contábil e Fiscal , responsável por garantir a execução correta das rotinas fiscais e contábeis de uma empresa de pequeno porte, com  estrutura societária composta por três CNPJs , cada um enquadrado em um regime tributário diferente:

  • Lucro Presumido
  • Lucro Real
  • SIMPLES Nacional

Apesar do porte enxuto, a operação possui  complexidade fiscal real , exigindo organização, atenção a detalhes e experiência prática com múltiplos regimes tributários.

Este cargo é essencial para assegurar  conformidade legal, rastreabilidade das informações e suporte à gestão financeira , atuando em interface direta com o escritório contábil terceirizado.

Como ter sucesso neste cargo

Para ter sucesso nesta posição, a pessoa precisa:

  • Ser altamente organizada e disciplinada
  • Ter experiência prática com rotinas fiscais em diferentes regimes tributários
  • Garantir segregação correta de informações por CNPJ
  • Cumprir prazos mensais de fechamento sem retrabalho
  • Comunicar-se de forma clara com áreas internas e contabilidade externa
  • Ter senso de responsabilidade e atenção a detalhes em um ambiente de empresa pequena

Como este cargo se encaixa na organização

O Analista Contábil e Fiscal atua como  pilar de sustentação da governança fiscal e contábil , conectando operações, financeiro e contabilidade externa.

É uma posição  operacional-chave , com impacto direto no controle de impostos, no fluxo de informações financeiras e na segurança fiscal da empresa.

Responsabilidades

  • Emitir  NF-e (produtos) e  NFS-e (serviços) , garantindo correta classificação fiscal
  • Emitir e controlar  notas fiscais de remessa, retorno, demonstração, garantia e entrada (importação)
  • Classificar corretamente as operações fiscais (CFOP, natureza da operação, CST/CSOSN e alíquotas)
  • Realizar  conciliações fiscais e contábeis mensais , segregadas por CNPJ
  • Organizar e preparar a documentação fiscal e financeira para envio ao  escritório contábil terceirizado
  • Apoiar a área financeira na conferência de faturamento e documentos fiscais
  • Manter arquivos fiscais e administrativos organizados, garantindo rastreabilidade entre pedido, nota fiscal e recebimento
  • Apoiar auditorias, fiscalizações e padronização de processos fiscais

Qualificações

  • Formação em  Contabilidade, Administração, Gestão Financeira ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prática com  Lucro Real, Lucro Presumido e SIMPLES Nacional
  • Conhecimento operacional de  IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, ICMS, ISS e IPI
  • Vivência com emissão de notas fiscais de produtos e serviços
  • Conhecimento intermediário de  Excel ou Google Sheets
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente de empresa pequena, com múltiplas responsabilidades

Beneficos: vale refeição, vale transporte, seguro de vida, celular empresarial.

Regime: Presencial - CLT 

Horário de trabalho: Segunda a sexta 8:12 hrs até as 18:00 hrs.

title: Document Controller
description:
Company Brief :

At Cyient, we are driven by a singular purpose—to improve the daily lives of people around the world. Whether it’s enabling a quieter flight, a safer train journey, a more affordable medical device, or a faster internet connection, our unwavering focus is on creating meaningful impact through innovation.

We are a trusted provider of engineering, manufacturing, and asset & operations management services, partnering with industry leaders across the globe to solve their complex challenges. With over 16,000 employees across 20+ countries, we support 12 key industries, including Aerospace, Rail Transportation, Power Generation, Communications, and Medical Technology. With a strong track record of growth and profitability, we remain deeply committed to building a sustainable future—actively investing in education and inclusive growth initiatives within the communities we operate in.

Job Description:

The Document Controller will manage and maintain project documentation to ensure accuracy, accessibility, and compliance with organizational and industry standards. This role supports engineering and project management teams by organizing, tracking, and safeguarding technical and commercial documents across the project lifecycle.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain document control systems (EDMS/DMS) for projects and operations.
  • Classify, index, and file documents (electronic and hard copy) with accurate metadata/attributes.
  • Monitor document workflows to ensure timely review, approval, and controlled distribution.
  • Maintain strict version control; ensure only current documents are in circulation.
  • Prepare and process transmittals; uphold document numbering procedures and naming conventions.
  • Coordinate submissions with internal teams and external stakeholders
  • Perform quality checks on deliverables (e.g., searchable PDFs, correct titles, revisions, attributes).
  • Generate regular status reports, registers, and KPI dashboards for document compliance.
  • Support audits and adhere to company QMS (ISO 9001)
  • Drive continuous improvement—cleanup duplicates/irrelevant files, optimize indexing and retrieval.

Required Attributes :

  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in document control/records management in Oil & Gas/Offshore Drilling/EPC/EPCm industries.
  • Hands-on with EDMS/DMS platforms (ACONEX, Oracle UNIFIER, SharePoint Online, eRoom, Meridian).Experience with OpenText’ is preferred.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and collaboration tools (Teams).
  • Familiarity with engineering documentation (e.g., P&IDs, PFLOW, vendor drawings, data books, specifications).
  • Strong attention to detail, organization skills, and ability to meet tight deadlines.

  • Conhecimentos de finanças corporativas, contabilidade e valuation.
  • Excel avançado (fórmulas, tabelas dinâmicas, gráficos, modelagem financeira).
  • Inglês avançado (leitura e interpretação de relatórios, calls e materiais internacionais).

  • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.
  • Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas tarefas e prazos.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.

  • Capacidade de trabalho em equipe em ambiente de alta performance.

  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento técnico e profissional de longo prazo.

title: Anti-Money Laundering Manager
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain AML/CFT and sanctions policies and procedures aligned with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Regulatory interface (inspections, responses, remediation plans)
  • Conduct customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews in accordance with risk-based methodologies.
  • Support ongoing transaction monitoring, screening, and investigation of suspicious activities.
  • Prepare, review, and file Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other regulatory filings with COAF or relevant authorities.
  • Monitor developments in AML/CFT and sanctions laws, and assist in updating internal procedures accordingly.
  • Assist in the delivery of internal training and awareness sessions on AML/CFT and sanctions compliance.
  • Conduct periodic risk assessments, ensuring all controls are operating effectively and aligned with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all compliance reviews, escalations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits, as well as inspections or information requests from regulators.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to strengthen compliance systems and data integrity.
  • Contribute to the assessment and oversight of third-party vendors that support AML/CFT and compliance operations.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience in financial, fintech, or VASP sectors.
  • Proven ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense.
  • Strong understanding of COAF, Central Bank of Brazil, and CVM regulations, as well as FATF standards.
  • Proficient in KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or related field; postgraduate or certification (e.g., CAMS, ICA) preferred.
  • Excellent analytical skills, professional integrity, and fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors, including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Our Mission At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission: Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. Who We Are This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Description Your Career The Regional Sales Manager is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. You’ll be responsible for meeting and exceeding your quota by crafting and implementing strategic territory plans targeting deployments of the Palo Alto Networks Next Generation Security Platform. This is a unique opportunity for a closer with a go-getter mentality to win business and market share by actively displacing competing technologies. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. Your Impact
  • As a Regional Sales Manager(Federal DoD and/or Civilian), you will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Bring your experience and consultative selling skills to initiate long-standing relationships with prospective customers and executive sponsors
  • Your focus will be to create and implement strategic account plans focused on attaining enterprise-wide deployments
  • Understanding of the strategic competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position Palo Alto Networks
  • Engage a programmatic approach to demand to generate, develop, and expand your territory
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meeting
Qualifications Your Experience
  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security context
  • Experience cultivating mutually beneficial relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Have and able to lead all aspects of the sales cycle with the ability to uncover, qualifying, developing, and closing new, white-space territories and accounts
  • Deep knowledge of the (U.S. DOD and/or intelligence community/or Civilian Agencies)
  • Possess a successful track record selling complex-solutions
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction
  • Highly competitive, ramp quickly, extremely adaptive, and pride yourself on exceeding production goals
Additional Information The Team Palo Alto Networks has brought technology to market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients. As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing sales person – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step. Our Commitment We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. Palo Alto Networks is evolving and changing the nature of work to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together. title: Senior Web Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join Street Diligence Inc. as a Senior Web Application Engineer, where you will play a key role in architecting and developing high-performance web applications. Your expertise in modern web development—including JavaScript frameworks, reusable UI components, and responsive design—will drive our innovative solutions. While experience with frameworks like Frappe and Django is an asset, we are primarily focused on robust full-stack development that leverages current technologies to build scalable and intuitive applications. A genuine passion for great user experiences is a must.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and Development:

  • Lead the design and development of complex, scalable web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue) along with backend technologies.
  • Build responsive, accessible, and engaging user interfaces that prioritize excellent user experiences.
  • Maintain a clean, efficient, and sustainable codebase following best practices.

Technical Leadership:

  • Mentor and provide technical guidance on modern web development practices, focusing on component-driven architectures and best coding practices.
  • Help conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high-quality software delivery.
  • Stay informed about emerging technologies and assess their potential to enhance our web development processes.
  • Help establish robust component libraries and expand object composition

Project Management:

  • Collaborate with project managers and cross-functional teams to define project scopes, requirements, and timelines.
  • Lead technical planning and architecture discussions, ensuring that projects meet both business and technical goals.
  • Ensure on-time delivery of projects with a consistent focus on quality.

Testing and Optimization:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive testing strategies to ensure the performance and reliability of our applications.
  • Demonstrate a passion for unit test coverage and behavior tests to maintain a high-quality codebase.
  • Optimize web applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Quickly diagnose and resolve complex technical issues.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate design concepts into functional, visually appealing interfaces.
  • Partner with backend engineers to define and implement robust API integrations.
  • Effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: A minimum of 5 years’ experience in web application development, with strong expertise in both frontend and backend technologies.
  • Technical Skills:
  • Proficient in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue).
  • Experience with backend technologies such as Django, Node.js, or similar frameworks.
  • Familiarity with building reusable UI components and integrating third-party APIs.
  • Additional Skills:
  • Strong understanding of SQL database technologies.
  • A passion for great user experiences, unit test coverage, and behavior tests.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a drive to build innovative solutions.
  • Outstanding communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

title: Desenvolvimento de Negócios Globais - Especialistas em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.

Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.

Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.

Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.

Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.

A tecnologia funciona.

Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.

Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:

Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.

Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.

Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.

Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.

É por isso que não queremos vendedores.

Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:

  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos

Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.

O que você vai realmente fazer:

  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo

Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.

Para quem é essa oportunidade:

  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira

Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.

É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.

O que oferecemos:

  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria

Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Exercer um papel técnico e consultivo (advisory), compartilhando conhecimento e melhores práticas em projetos e melhorias relacionadas aos sistemas;
  • Alinhamento com o negócio: Garantir que as necessidades do negócio sejam corretamente compreendidas e traduzidas em soluções tecnológicas viáveis. Facilitar a comunicação entre equipes de TI e de negócio, assegurando alinhamento e eficiência na entrega;

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.

The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.

The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.

Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).

What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .

Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

Nossa Cultura

Na Koala, valorizamos muito mais do que resultados: valorizamos como eles são alcançados. Somos uma empresa em crescimento acelerado, sempre guiados por propósito, colaboração e espírito de dono.

Nosso ambiente é:

- Focado em performance, mas sem abrir mão do cuidado e da transparência.

  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo dos pedidos, devoluções, trocas e logística, sinalizando pontos de atenção;
  • Realizar cadastros de produtos do Meli e de produtos Amazon e outros marketplaces;
  • Auxiliar na análise de desempenho das vendas por meio de relatórios e indicadores, colaborando com estratégias de melhoria;

Requisitos

  • Ensino Médio completo (desejável curso técnico ou Superior em andamento ou completo em Administração, Marketing, Logística, TI ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência prévia com operações de e-commerce ou suporte digital;
  • Domínio básico/intermediário de ferramentas digitais e Google Workspace (especialmente Google Sheets); 
  • Organização, proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar com metas e prazos. 

Benefícios e Vantagens

  • Ambiente jovem, dinâmico e inovador;
  • Wellhub;
  • VA/VR;

  • Escritório moderno e inspirador em Porto Alegre (com café e boas conversas garantidas);

title: Gerente de Negócios - TI

O foco será gerenciar e atender às demandas relacionadas a Fundos de Investimentos, abrangendo canais de integração, sistemas legados, interação com fornecedores e eventualmente demais segmentos como Renda Fixa e Renda Variável.

Somos um time de pessoas engajadas e com um espírito positivo, todos comprometidos em fazer a diferença na vida de nossos clientes. Sabemos que o mercado financeiro é dinâmico e desafiador – e é justamente esse ambiente que nos motiva. Com a constante transformação digital do setor, estamos em um processo contínuo de inovação e aprimoramento de nossos processos.

Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e finanças, e está em busca de novos desafios, venha fazer parte de nosso time!

  • Liderar a equipe de analistas de TI, garantindo a execução eficiente, promovendo alta performance e disseminando cultura na condução das atividades e projetos.
  • Realizar feedbacks da equipe e trabalhar motivação e engajamento.
  • Gerenciar a relação com desenvolvimento interno e fornecedores de sistemas, assegurando a entrega de soluções de qualidade.
  • Planejar, orçar e gerenciar projetos, assegurando cumprimento de prazos e qualidade
  • Administrar as demandas das áreas usuárias, garantindo alinhamento estratégico com a alta gestão de forma a garantir atendimento de expectativas e prazos.
  • Tomar decisões técnicas de forma autônoma, garantindo a continuidade e eficiência dos processos.
  • Acompanhar e otimizar o desempenho da equipe por meio de indicadores (KPIs).
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas, gerenciar crises e conduzir time e projetos.
  • Liderar a transformação digital e adoção de novas tecnologias na área

Requisitos e Competências

  • Experiência comprovada em empresas do setor financeiro ou fintechs.
  • Conhecimento básico em SQL Server , Windows Server , Web Services e APIs .
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento.

Diferencial:

  • Contribuir com o crescimento técnico do time, efetuando treinamentos, aconselhamentos (mentoria) e supervisão de pessoas desenvolvedoras menos experientes, sempre que necessário;
  • Contribuir para a produção de padrões e documentação de melhores práticas para a sua equipe e garantir que o desenvolvimento atenda a esses padrões;
  • Apoiar em práticas de desenvolvimento ágil.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Compreensão de arquiteturas para processamento de grandes volumes de dados (repositórios, filas, microsserviços, etc);
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (da concepção à entrega, sustentação e operação, desenvolvimento orientado a testes, escrita e documentação de códigos, code review, etc);

  • Linguagens de programação (Go, NodeJS, SQL);
  • Banco de dados relacionais, não relacionais, colunares/AVRO e elásticos (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc);

  • Pró-eficiência no desenvolvimento de:
  • API Rest;
  • Programação concorrente e escalável;
  • Conhecimento nos processos de versionamento e práticas CI/CD;
  • Experiência com práticas de Code Review e Feedback;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Apresentar boa comunicação, pois somos um time bastante pró ativo e com necessidade de articulação de ideias;
  • Encarar as mudanças como oportunidades e aprender com seus erros;
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Promover nossa cultura e valores;
  • Saber como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutar do trabalho em equipe.

Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

title: Analista Contábil Jr
description:

Venha fazer parte do nosso time como Analista Contábil Jr , o qual será responsável por executar e apoiar as rotinas contábeis, fiscais e regulatórias da corretora de investimentos e demais empresas do Grupo, assegurando a conformidade com as normas contábeis, tributárias e exigências do Banco Central. title: Analista de Operações de RH
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO

  • Executar as rotinas da área de Operações de RH conforme os procedimentos da empresa com foco no resultado, assertividade e dentro dos prazos legais. Apoiar as demais áreas de RH, com discrição e confidencialidade. Assegurar o cumprimento da legislação trabalhista vigente.

  • Acompanhar as rescisões e assegurar a inclusão das informações no Ardagh People, base de dados global e ADP, sistema de folha de pagamento e validar os cálculos na folha de pagamento.
  • Analisar ofícios judiciais, assegurar o cadastro das regras de cálculo na ADP, conferir e providenciar o pagamento mensal para as pessoas informadas.
  • Garantir mensalmente o processamento das férias conforme programação e assegurar o cálculo e pagamento correto para os funcionários;
  • Analisar e assegurar o cumprimento dos Acordos Coletivos vigentes e a aplicação das normas legais nos processos relacionados a gestão de pessoas;
  • Garantir mensalmente o processamento da folha de pagamento conforme as rotinas da área e assegurar o cálculo e pagamento correto para os funcionários conforme legislação vigente;
  • Validar a folha de pagamento e providenciar o recolhimento dos encargos conforme legislação vigente;
  • Validar e providenciar mensalmente a análise contábil da folha de pagamento;
  • Atender auditoria e fiscalizações, apresentar documentação requerida e prestar esclarecimentos dos processos da área se necessário.

Formação

Superior completo

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

  • Conhecimentos básicos administração de pessoal
  • Conhecimentos básicos de legislação trabalhista
  • Pacote office generalista
  • Conhecimento ADP
  • Excel intermediário
  • Conhecimentos e análise crítica de legislação trabalhista
  • Folha de Pagamento e contabilização
  • E-social e obrigações acessórias

Sobre a Ardagh:

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!

Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

Na Ardagh, temos a consciência da singularidade de cada ser humano. Valorizamos e respeitamos a diversidade da nossa rede de colaboradores. Aqui, você pode ser você, contribuindo com suas experiências para o nosso negócio. Afinal, cada um é um mundo, e, na Ardagh, todo mundo importa! Gostou? #VEM ser você :)

Se seu perfil corresponde à vaga, candidate-se a essa posição e #VEMserLateiroAMP.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the opportunity:

Location :Remote BR/Latam

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform . In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

Skills/Experience:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree

Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Cientista de Dados

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About Teachable:

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? As part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is the role?

This is a Senior Customer Success Analyst role for someone who operates comfortably without a fixed scope, moves fluidly between strategy and execution, and takes ownership not just of relationships, but of outcomes.

At Teachable, creators are entrepreneurs who build, market, and scale digital education businesses, using our platform as their core operating system. You will own a portfolio of high-potential creators and drive retention, growth, and expansion by acting as a strategic and tactical advisor. This role goes beyond relationship management: you will diagnose business challenges, form a point of view, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations that help creators scale their businesses through product adoption, marketing, and growth strategies.

As our Customer Success model continues to evolve, the scope and engagement approach of your portfolio may change over time. This role is well-suited for someone who is comfortable operating in this context and adjusting priorities thoughtfully as the team scales.

In this role you’ll:

  • Own and manage a portfolio of high-potential creators, where portfolio size, composition, and engagement approach may evolve over time as our Customer Success model continues to take shape.
  • Be accountable for retention and growth outcomes across your portfolio by turning goals into concrete success plans, defining what “good” looks like for each account, and influencing customer decisions through clear recommendations, follow-ups, and next steps.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by diagnosing business problems, forming a point of view, and recommending specific actions related to sales, marketing, monetization, and platform usage. This role requires comfort moving from strategy to tactics (including discussing offers, funnels, launches, pricing, and distribution) and clearly articulating what the customer should do next.
  • Engage directly and hands-on with creators across your portfolio, flexing between high-touch 1:1 support and scalable engagement models as needed. You will help design, run, and iterate on scalable initiatives (e.g. group coaching, campaigns, enablement content) as we continue to evolve our engagement playbooks.
  • Drive product adoption by connecting Teachable’s features and tools to concrete business use cases, helping creators understand what to adopt, when to adopt it, and how it supports their growth.
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, PMM, Sales, Support, Data, and Revenue Operations to surface customer insights, align on priorities, and influence decisions that improve the end-to-end creator experience.
  • Actively contribute to the evolution of our Customer Success function by identifying patterns across your portfolio, testing new approaches, documenting what works (and what doesn’t), and translating individual insights into repeatable motions for the broader team.

Must haves:

  • 4+ years of experience owning a book of business in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or Business Development, with direct responsibility for retention, expansion, or revenue outcomes, beyond relationship maintenance
  • Experience managing a portfolio where growth was not guaranteed, requiring you to diagnose why accounts were plateauing and to take ownership of changing those outcomes
  • Proven ability to advise customers running complex businesses, with multiple stakeholders and unclear paths to growth, translating ambiguity into clear priorities and execution plans
  • Demonstrated comfort operating across high-touch and scaled engagement models, including knowing when to go deep 1:1 and when to drive impact through programs, campaigns, or enablement
  • Ability to develop a clear point of view, challenge customer assumptions, and influence decisions
  • Track record of turning incomplete data and weak signals into structured action plans, and following through to drive measurable business results
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience using customer, revenue, and product data to identify risks, opportunities, and concrete levers for growth
  • Practical experience using CRM and analytics tools to actively manage, prioritize, and evolve a portfolio strategy
  • Fluent in English, with confidence leading both strategic and tactical conversations (all of your portfolio will speak english)

Nice to haves:

  • Experience working with founders, creators, or entrepreneurs who own both strategy and execution of their businesses
  • Background in growth, monetization, or go-to-market strategy, particularly in digital or SaaS businesses
  • Experience designing, running, or iterating on scaled Customer Success motions (programs, group coaching, campaigns, enablement) alongside 1:1 engagement

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Enjoy a proactive, growth-oriented Customer Success role , where you go beyond relationship maintenance and actively identify opportunities to drive customer impact
  • Thrive in a dynamic environment , managing evolving portfolios and adapting your engagement approach as customer needs change
  • Prefer working with autonomy and judgment , using your experience to make decisions rather than relying solely on rigid playbooks

This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties:

You’ll own the delivery lifecycle end-to-end — from architecture and design to production reliability, technical mentorship, and stakeholder alignment. We’re looking for someone who can turn complex requirements into secure, scalable, high-quality software — and help the team grow in the process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own architecture and design: create system diagrams, define functional and non-functional requirements (such as scalability, reliability, security and cost), and set integration standards.
  • Build and deliver using our technology stack (see below) with focus on quality, performance, and observability.
  • Lead initiatives: break down roadmaps, manage small to medium-sized projects, remove blockers, and ensure on-time delivery.
  • Plan and prioritize: create execution plans, estimate effort, manage risks, and clearly communicate progress to stakeholders.
  • Drive engineering excellence: enforce automated testing (unit, integration, e2e), deep code reviews, branch and release standards, and code quality.
  • Document for scale: maintain architecture documents, ADRs, operational guides, and runbooks, ensuring traceability and clarity within agile processes and tools.
  • Client interaction: attend remote and in-person meetings, capture requirements, discuss trade-offs, and present solutions clearly.
  • Mentor others: guide mid-level and junior developers, share best practices, lead tech talks, and promote a learning culture.
  • Partner management: coordinate third parties, validate deliverables, and ensure alignment with project goals.
  • Ensure production quality: validate system integrations, instrument logs, metrics, and tracing, define basic SLOs, and participate in post-mortems.
  • Continuous learning: explore new technologies, identify process improvements, and propose architectural enhancements.
  • Administrative support: handle operational requests and be available for national or international travel when required.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience, including technical leadership on complex projects.
  • Stack: Backend (Java, Python and .Net Core), Frontend (Angular), Node.js, SQL, strong background in REST API development, microservices and event-driven architectures.
  • Cloud: Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure, IAM (Identity and Access Management), storage, managed services and observability.
  • Quality & DevOps: Test automation, Git, Gitflow, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, semantic versioning and promotion across environments.
  • Security & Reliability: Familiarity with OWASP Top 10, secret management, least privilege, basic hardening, and observability (logs, metrics, tracing).
  • Language: Advanced English (written and spoken, client-facing).
  • Profile: Proactive, system thinker, fluent with modern frameworks and best practices in development, testing, and cloud operations.

Nice to have:

  • Postgraduate or Master’s degree.
  • Spanish proficiency.
  • IaC (Terraform) and platform engineering principles.
  • Multi-cloud experience (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cost/performance optimization.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analystwith a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity,

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!

What You’ll Do:

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!
